slice: natural explaining: a hive's collective intelligence as podaling, trips out and back across and along the surface around now-existing

items.text: A hive's collective intelligence is podaling: its foragers' trips out and back, away and back, go across and along the surface around a hive's now-existing, each forager with her own source and only a parity going across at a dance, and a hive is co-competencing the observings of many trips. Podaling exchanges its across and its along while each forager goes on forward, and a hive's intelligence is its surface around now-existing co-intelligencing, in no forager alone.

In Seeley, Camazine and Sneyd's account, a honey bee forager judges only her own nectar source, its profitability, with no comparing among sources: from a richer source she works faster, dances more intensely and is less likely to abandon it, and from a poorer one the reverse, and a colony's preference for its better sources arises from these. No forager compares sources; each trip's parity goes across at a dance, and a colony's choosing is a podaling.

items.section: 4.6 A reaching's competency constant, a gathering's climbing
items.text: A young bumblebee, within a day or two of coming out, flies complex loops of ever-increasing size around its colony, and with experience flies direct paths, mostly upwind on its outward trips, though forage is in each direction. Each loop, a going away and a going back on one ring, is a podal at one bee's scale, each loop reaching further across and along the surface around its colony's now-existing.

A hive's foragers going out and back illustrate podaling: away and back, across and along, each forager with her own source and only a parity going across at a dance, a hive's surface around now-existing co-intelligencing in no forager alone.
